I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I said I'd noted that the next renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. is 10 June, which replaces the date she posted in #north-team this morning.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't open #north-team or change anything else. The renewal date counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed to mention it.
